criteria.rowMapping: The page always supplies explicit baseStockMatches. Each original source line uses its confirmed ProdKey after source-row validation, never a name-alias lookup. Omitted mappings retain legacy helper compatibility only. Same-name rows with distinct product IDs remain distinct; true duplicate IDs block with involved source line numbers. Invalid or stale row mappings never fall back to auto matching. Numeric exclusions must preserve original line identity. Exact week-plus-stock-title headers are not products; fullwidth digits parse without changing original names or memo text.
criteria.authority: Only exact current full-year/week/base/paste/base-week/mapping/exclusion scope with verified successful committed bulk-result rows (failCount zero), never preview records, rolled back, undone, failed or duplicate entries. Accumulate successive per-customer committed operations with unique execution IDs and restore that accumulator in existing pasteWorkspace. ADD subtracts original input quantity, CANCEL adds it only when actual transaction shipment before/after changed in that direction; zero delta does not consume again. Do not use current cumulative shipment quantities. Verified operation facts live independently of dismissible bulkResult in appliedStockLedger and survive failed retries and workspace reload. Unsupported absolute distribution requires a fresh base/scope before copy; undo invalidates the ledger.
criteria.format: Keep original base-stock input names, numeric token formatting, units, headers, separators and two-line name/quantity structure. Sort product blocks by matched DB ProdName using English A-Z ordering within source header/separator sections; omit exactly zero vectors only, retain positive fractions. Explicit excluded lines and exact signed text ranges use textWithoutExcludedLines, same as analysis/parser; raw source remains the scope fingerprint.
criteria.safety: Unknown product, duplicate base product, unit mismatch, invalid quantity and negative remainder disable applied copy with explicit warnings; never clamp. No unit conversion is invented; mixed box/detail quantities updated independently. Missing unit follows existing parser main-box semantics.
criteria.source: pages/api/products/search.js full-list ORDER BY CounName, FlowerName, ProdName; source matching keys from existing resolved product matches. Original base text and current successful result are independently persisted in existing pasteWorkspace.
criteria.changeDisplay: buildAppliedStockCopy returns changeRows only after every copy safety predicate succeeds. Each original product name shows start, ADD consumption, CANCEL return and applied vectors in the original main/detail units. Formula start + CANCEL - ADD shares the clipboard computation, not preview or ERP ProductStock. Zero remainder and unchanged products remain in the table; only copy text omits zero vectors. Failed, stale, cross-year, duplicate, negative or unit-unknown results expose no applied change rows.
criteria.reviewButton: The result column exposes 적용재고 확인 before long result details. It opens a read-only modal titled 기초재고 기준 적용재고, never executes or retries an ERP action. Before a result exists it explains that execution and verification are required. Unsafe results expose reasons, never stock rows or enabled copy. Closing via close button or Escape returns focus to the trigger. Current scope/result changes immediately invalidate stale content through buildAppliedStockCopy; copying never bypasses ready. At 1920x1080 and smaller viewports the modal stays centered despite the global margin reset, within the viewport with a reachable header, close/copy controls, and scrollable body. Clipboard failure keeps selectable original text.
